import re
from docx import Document
from docx.shared import Pt, Inches, RGBColor
from docx.enum.text import WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH
from docx.enum.table import WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT
from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.oxml import OxmlElement

doc = Document()
sec = doc.sections[0]
sec.left_margin = sec.right_margin = Inches(1)
sec.top_margin = sec.bottom_margin = Inches(1)
st = doc.styles["Normal"]
st.font.name = "Calibri"; st.font.size = Pt(10.5)
st.element.rPr.rFonts.set(qn("w:eastAsia"), "Calibri")
for name, size in [("Heading 1", 13), ("Heading 2", 11.5), ("Heading 3", 10.5)]:
    s = doc.styles[name]; s.font.name = "Calibri"; s.font.size = Pt(size); s.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0x1F,0x3A,0x5F)

def _runs(p, text, size=None, italic=False):
    parts = re.split(r"(\*\*.+?\*\*)", text)
    for part in parts:
        if not part: continue
        if part.startswith("**") and part.endswith("**"):
            r = p.add_run(part[2:-2]); r.bold = True
        else:
            r = p.add_run(part)
        if size: r.font.size = Pt(size)
        if italic: r.italic = True
    return p

def H(level, text):
    return doc.add_heading(text, level=level)

def P(text, align=None, size=None, italic=False, space_after=6, indent=None):
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    _runs(p, text, size=size, italic=italic)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(space_after)
    if align == "center": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.CENTER
    if align == "justify": p.alignment = WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH.JUSTIFY
    if indent: p.paragraph_format.left_indent = Inches(indent)
    return p

def B(text, level=0):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Bullet" if level == 0 else "List Bullet 2")
    _runs(p, text)
    p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def N(text):
    p = doc.add_paragraph(style="List Number")
    _runs(p, text); p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return p

def Q(text):
    """Proposed language block (indented, boxed look)"""
    p = doc.add_paragraph()
    _runs(p, text, size=10, italic=False)
    pf = p.paragraph_format
    pf.left_indent = Inches(0.4); pf.right_indent = Inches(0.3); pf.space_after = Pt(6)
    pPr = p._p.get_or_add_pPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), "EEF3F8")
    pPr.append(shd)
    return p

def shade(cell, fill):
    tcPr = cell._tc.get_or_add_tcPr()
    shd = OxmlElement("w:shd"); shd.set(qn("w:val"), "clear"); shd.set(qn("w:color"), "auto"); shd.set(qn("w:fill"), fill)
    tcPr.append(shd)

SEV = {"Critical": "F4CCCC", "Major": "FCE5CD", "Minor": "FFF2CC"}

def T(rows, widths, header=True, size=9, sevcol=None):
    t = doc.add_table(rows=len(rows), cols=len(rows[0]))
    t.style = "Table Grid"; t.alignment = WD_TABLE_ALIGNMENT.CENTER
    t.autofit = False
    for i, row in enumerate(rows):
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            c = t.cell(i, j); c.width = Inches(widths[j])
            c.text = ""
            p = c.paragraphs[0]
            _runs(p, str(val), size=size)
            p.paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(0)
            if header and i == 0:
                for r in p.runs: r.bold = True
                shade(c, "1F3A5F")
                for r in p.runs: r.font.color.rgb = RGBColor(0xFF,0xFF,0xFF)
            elif sevcol is not None and j == sevcol:
                for k, f in SEV.items():
                    if str(val).startswith(k): shade(c, f)
    # set grid widths
    tbl = t._tbl
    grid = tbl.tblGrid
    for j, gc in enumerate(grid.findall(qn("w:gridCol"))):
        gc.set(qn("w:w"), str(int(widths[j]*1440)))
    doc.add_paragraph().paragraph_format.space_after = Pt(2)
    return t

def FINDING(fid, title, sev, refs, authority, deficiency, risk, remediation, language=None):
    H(3, f"{fid}  {title}  [{sev}]")
    T([["Severity", sev], ["Protocol / ICF reference", refs], ["Governing authority", authority]], [1.6, 4.9], header=False, size=9, sevcol=None)
    P("**Deficiency.** " + deficiency, align="justify")
    P("**Regulatory risk.** " + risk, align="justify")
    if isinstance(remediation, list):
        P("**Recommended remediation.**", space_after=2)
        for r in remediation: B(r)
    else:
        P("**Recommended remediation.** " + remediation, align="justify")
    if language:
        P("**Proposed language** (for Trident drafting; to be conformed by Pinnacle Clinical/Biostatistics):", space_after=2)
        for l in (language if isinstance(language, list) else [language]): Q(l)

FINDING("M-7", "Sample-size calculation does not support the stated 80% power", "Major",
 "§10.1, Table 5 and Table 1 (78 evaluable per arm; “78 / 0.85 ≈ 92, rounded to 90”); §10.4 (Hochberg across three dose comparisons); §10.3 (interim alpha spending)",
 "ICH E9 §3.5 (sample size); 21 CFR 312.23(a)(6)(iii); 312.42(b)(2)(ii); Minutes §5 (assumptions “generally reasonable,” with alpha “adjusted for multiplicity”)",
 "FDA accepted the **assumptions** (30% placebo vs. 45% at 30 mg, 80% power, two-sided α 0.05 adjusted for multiplicity, 15% dropout). On our arithmetic, the **calculation** in §10.1 does not follow from them. With the standard normal-approximation formula for two proportions, 30% vs. 45% at two-sided α = 0.05 and 80% power needs about **163 evaluable subjects per arm** (about 175 with continuity correction), not 78. At 76.5 evaluable per arm (90 × 0.85), the power for the stated difference is about **48%**. In addition: (i) 78/0.85 is 91.8, which the Protocol rounds **down** to 90, below its own evaluable target; (ii) the calculation makes no allowance for the Hochberg procedure across three dose comparisons (§10.4) or for the alpha spent at the interim analysis (§10.3), although FDA understood the alpha would be “adjusted for multiplicity”; and (iii) §10.4 calls 30 mg vs. placebo “the primary comparison” while applying Hochberg to all three comparisons. Those two statements are inconsistent.",
 "A dose-ranging Phase 2b study need not be powered for every comparison. But a protocol that states 80% power when the design delivers roughly half that power is an inaccuracy in a required IND element (§312.23(a)(6)(iii)). It risks a “clearly deficient in design” comment under §312.42(b)(2)(ii) and erodes credibility on the statistical matters FDA discussed. Correcting it may change enrollment, the number of sites and the $67.4 million budget, so it needs an early decision.",
 ["Pinnacle Biostatistics (Dr. Lattimore) to re-run and document the calculation, including software, test (CMH vs. chi-square), multiplicity and interim adjustments. Then either (a) increase the sample size, (b) restate the objective and power claim (e.g., as dose-response estimation via MCP-Mod/Emax with an appropriate power statement), or (c) revise the assumptions with a cited justification.",
  "Reconcile the primary-comparison language with the Hochberg family, and integrate the key secondary hierarchy (§10.5) into one prespecified multiplicity strategy (e.g., a graphical approach), as FDA requested (Minutes §5).",
  "If the sample size changes materially, consider informing the Division before submission (Type C meeting or written request)."])
